answer: Fund a shared insurance pool from per-identity bonds. Each agent locks a bond before earning, and its payout each epoch is capped at a fixed fraction of that live stake, so claimed reward scales one-to-one with capital at risk, never with headcount. Map every bond on a public atlas; when an audit proves fraud, the cheat's bond is forfeited to refund those it harmed. A farm of fakes must post a full bond per persona with zero leverage, and the marginal delta of each extra identity is pure sunk collateral woven into one trellis of mutual liability.
